title: Zesty Chewy Paella Moroccan Paella Rice Paella
description: Pungent, chewy, show-off Moroccan dish featuring paella rice, smoke-cold, high-protein-friendly. Served in individual ramekins for a unique presentation.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, Moroccan spice blend, smoked paprika, and almond flour. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the paella rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the lemon juice, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to 4-6 ramekins and top each with a few pitted green olives.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 5-7 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the ramekins cool for a few minutes before serving.
Use oven mitts to handle the hot ramekins.
To prevent the rice from drying out, make sure to use a non-stick skillet and stir the rice frequently while it cooks.
If using individual ramekins, be sure to grease them lightly with oil or cooking spray to prevent the rice from sticking.
Consider using a kitchen torch to lightly brown the top of the rice for a more golden-brown color.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
